old_problem: The source does not name nvbandwidth testcases, paths, buffer/sample settings, statistic or performance limits. The prior review therefore treated the missing Project SPEC as preventing even a review-layer method.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA's official nvbandwidth interface supplies a safe discovery and exact-selection method (`--version`, `--list`, `--testcase`, JSON output, buffer size and samples). ED-03 permits the required path matrix and topology to be runtime project configuration, while ED-15 forbids PASS until signed per-path thresholds/tolerances exist and ED-14 forbids shortening the stated long run. Thus the review can be completed without inventing acceptance values.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row459 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3047 and next formal queue Stability row3/history3048.

The official NVIDIA README defines nvbandwidth as a bandwidth tool for host/GPU and GPU/GPU copy paths and supports explicit testcase listing/selection, UUID pair selection, sample count, buffer size and JSON output.
The source's 60-minute attended and 100-minute machine estimates are retained as planning metadata; execution must use the owner-approved complete profile and cannot be replaced by a short smoke run.
No generic GB/s limit is authoritative across GPU SKU, NVLink/PCIe topology, direction and copy method; numeric PASS remains gated by the signed Project SPEC.
Directly read next formal queue Stability row3 and verified its manifest identity; no package download/build, benchmark, load, log clearing or DUT action ran.

test_case.purpose: Measure every project-required host↔GPU and GPU↔GPU path with the pinned nvbandwidth build and prove each named direction/method meets its topology-specific signed threshold without health degradation.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA nvbandwidth release/commit, source/binary checksum and build manifest
Supported CUDA Toolkit/driver plus GPU SKU/serial/UUID/BDF and NVLink/PCIe topology map
Project-required testcase/path/direction matrix, buffer size, samples, statistic and runtime profile
Per-path metric units, numeric threshold/tolerance and unsupported/skipped-path policy
test_case.test_command: Verify the package checksum and `nvbandwidth --version`; capture GPU UUID/BDF/topology and health; save `nvbandwidth --list`; validate the signed profile maps every required testcase/path to the current topology; execute only that complete profile using explicit `--testcase`/`--pair` as applicable, approved `--bufferSize` and `--testSamples`, and `--format json`; preserve raw JSON/stdout/stderr and synchronized health telemetry; compare each required result with its signed per-path threshold. Do not default to an unknown full suite or shorten the approved duration.
test_case.expected_result: All required named paths execute with the approved settings and verification enabled, produce parseable metrics in the specified units/statistic, satisfy their own signed thresholds/tolerances, contain no unauthorized skip/unsupported/error status, and leave GPU/interconnect/host health within approved limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact artifact/topology/profile identity, complete required row/path coverage, per-path numeric comparisons and healthy telemetry. Tool exit zero, presence of positive GB/s values, an aggregate average, or an execution without approved thresholds is not PASS and remains execution BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Validate package provenance, compatible CUDA/driver and immutable GPU UUID/BDF topology before load
Approve full runtime, cooling/power capacity and every selected path; preserve data verification
Abort on Xid/AER, link degradation, thermal/power limit, hang or topology change
Preserve complete output; no automatic retry, ad-hoc tuning or log clearing
expected_evidence: GPU UUID/BDF and NVLink/PCIe topology plus approved path/profile manifest
Exact command/settings, complete JSON/raw output and per-path coverage diff
Per-path threshold/tolerance calculations and skipped/unsupported disposition
Synchronized health telemetry, recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on package/topology/profile mismatch or any health/benchmark error, preserve all artifacts, terminate the workload, restore only recorded temporary settings and allow the SUT to cool/return to baseline. A corrected profile or rerun needs separate authorization.

source_conflict.reason: The source is incomplete rather than contradictory; the official tool interface supports parameterization without inventing a Project SPEC.

blocked.reason: A complete safe review-layer method is now defined. Execution verdict remains gated by the signed profile and thresholds, but that runtime configuration does not keep the engineering review blocked.
